hypothesis: When a per-program stream contains both rows with the current release_batch_delivery_position and rows without it, the adapter must fail closed rather than independently interpreting the missing-field rows as legacy schema. Otherwise an incomplete stream can be promoted to a unique attribution.
red_green: The mixed-schema regression first failed against the T4 prototype: trace_integrity SOURCE_ROWS_JOINED and attribution TEMPORALLY_UNIQUE. The T5 batch-mode consistency check changed that same fixture to HOLD_INCOMPLETE_RELEASE_BATCH and UNRESOLVED.

decision_gate.pass: mixed legacy/current rows for one program batch identifier are HOLD/UNRESOLVED; all prior valid, malformed, incomplete, duplicate and gap cases retain expected dispositions.
decision_gate.fail: mixed telemetry receives SOURCE_ROWS_JOINED or a unique attribution.

limits: Synthetic producer-shaped rows and adapter construction only. No current-main runtime execution, GUI, OS input, game, model, live lane, application effect, causal attribution, safety, recovery, latency or task completion claim.
